content.comment_body: Is it possible to connect [product_name] [article_no] (or similar modules) to an inexpensive text display like this one using RS232? [url]

No, it's not possible! The communication between [product_name] and its operator device uses a proprietary bus and protocol, not RS232. Even if a connector has a 9-pin sub-d, it doesn't mean it's RS232.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are attempting to link [product_name] ([article_no] version) to budget-friendly third-party text displays with RS232, but are facing compatibility challenges. The main issue involves the communication protocol: [product_name] and its operator devices use a proprietary bus and protocol that do not work with standard RS232 text displays, even though the connectors might look identical. This reveals a lack of interoperability for users seeking low-cost display solutions.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect to utilize standard RS232 communication to connect [product_name] to inexpensive, non-[company_name] text displays.
